cause_confirmation.method: static inspection of /app/dist/tools-Bm4OUTgF.js in the pinned image (docker run --entrypoint sh, grep)
cause_confirmation.found: createCachedDescriptorPluginTool (line 477-490), the cold-load path (653-704) and resolvePluginTools (727-765) load a plugin registry at tool execute time with activate:false and toolDiscovery:true; each registry load calls the plugin's register() again, while before_tool_call hooks run from the global hook runner. The hook's closure and the tool's closure can therefore belong to different register() calls.
cause_confirmation.not_measured: a live gateway process was not started, so the exact register() count per process and which instance served each of the 14 11/19 calls is inferred from the code path plus the logged 14x authorize 200 / 14x call_not_authorized_by_hook, not counted at runtime

fix: Authorization is no longer held in plugin memory. The hook's /authorize call (with host tool_call_id) makes the broker record (agent_id, session_key, tool_call_id, tool, run_id); /call (agent, session, tool_call_id from the host tool context) consumes it exactly once and takes run_id from the record. A call with no record, another agent, session or tool, an expired record, or a forged run_id is refused (403). Identity still comes only from host context, never model params; a broker refusal/timeout in the hook still blocks.
